title: HTran and the Advanced Persistent Threat

evidences.text: While researching one of the malware families involved in the RSA breach disclosed in March 2011, Dell SecureWorks CTU observed an interesting pattern in the network traffic of a related sample (MD5:53ba6845f57f8e9ef600ef166be3be14).

When the sample under analysis attempted to connect to the C2 server at my.amazingrm.com (203.92.45.2), the server returned a suc- cinct plain-text error message instead of the expected HTTP-formatted response:
